properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 11 at 7:37AM CST by NWS Quad Cities IA IL
properties.description:
At 734 AM CST, trained weather spotters reported strong
thunderstorms along a line extending from Lost Nation to Marengo.
Another strong storm was located just north of Durant. Movement of
all storms was east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Pea to penny size hail. Large amounts of small hail
covering the ground and hindering travel in some locations.

SOURCE...Trained weather spotters.

IMPACT...Minor damage to outdoor objects is possible.

Locations impacted include...
Cedar Rapids, Iowa City, Maquoketa, Tipton, West Branch,
Mechanicsville, Stanwood, Marion, Coralville, North Liberty,
Eldridge, DeWitt, Mount Vernon, Lisbon, Fairfax, Solon, Tiffin, Ely,
Atkins, and Port Byron.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 80 in Iowa between mile markers 227 and 264.
Interstate 380 between mile markers 1 and 22.
properties.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with these storms.
Lightning can strike 10 miles away from a thunderstorm. Seek a safe
shelter inside a building or vehicle.

NWSheadline: A cluster of strong thunderstorms will impact portions of northeastern Rock Island, northern Scott, western Clinton, southern Linn, northeastern Iowa, southern Benton, southwestern Jackson, Cedar, southern Jones and northern Johnson Counties through 815 AM CST

properties.areaDesc: Southwestern Humboldt; Coastal Mendocino
properties.headline: High Surf Warning issued November 11 at 5:32AM PST until November 15 at 4:00AM PST by NWS Eureka CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Dangerously large breaking waves 25 to 35 ft.

* WHERE...Southwestern Humboldt and Coastal Mendocino Counties.

* WHEN...From 4 PM Friday to 4 AM PST Sunday. .

* IMPACTS...Breaking waves can sweep people off jetties and
docks, and into dangerous seas. Life-threatening surf
conditions and significant beach erosion can be expected.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...After only brief improvement late Saturday
through Sunday, a second large swell is forecast late Sunday
through Monday.
properties.instruction:
Large breaking waves along the coast will lead to increased wave
run-up on beaches with waves topping and washing over large rocks
and jetties. These large waves can be erratic and unpredictable.
Use extra caution near the surf zone as these large waves will be
capable of sweeping people into the frigid and turbulent ocean
water. Mariners traversing the bar are urged to exercise extreme
caution or stay in port until the threat subsides. Please contact
the U.S. Coast Guard for information regarding harbor and bar
closures.

properties.description:
* WHAT...Dangerously large breaking waves of 20 to 25 ft Friday,
increasing to 30 to 35 ft late Friday through Saturday.

* WHERE...Beaches of Curry, Coos and Douglas Counties. This
includes Charleston, Port Orford, Gold Beach, and Brookings.

* WHEN...From 10 AM Friday to 10 PM PST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Extremely large breaking waves will create very
dangerous conditions along beaches and area shorelines. Waves
will inundate beaches and surge into normally dry areas.
Infrastructure damage and significant beach erosion can be
expected.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Conditions improve somewhat late Saturday
afternoon as breaking wave heights lower to 24 to 27 ft, but
conditions are likely remain hazardous for area beaches through
Sunday and possibly even into Monday.

* View the hazard area in detail at
https://www.wrh.noaa.gov/map/?wfo=mfr
properties.instruction:

and life-threatening surf conditions. Stay off of beaches, rocks,
jetties,piers, and other waterside infrastructure.

properties.description:
...The Flood Advisory continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Los Olmos Creek Near Falfurrias affecting Brooks County.

.Latest observations show that Low Olmos Creek near Falfurrias has
risen to Action Stage (5.0 feet) with a current level of 6.21 feet.
Levels are expected to remain above Action Stage through tonight and
likely through Wednesday (at least).

For the Los Olmos Creek...including Falfurrias...elevated river
levels are forecast.

* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Los Olmos Creek near Falfurrias.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 7.0 feet, Minor lowland flooding reaches 120 feet wide
into flood plain-persons vulnerable to lowland flooding should move
equipment to higher ground

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 4:15 PM CST Tuesday the stage was 6.5 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 5.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 6.7 feet
tomorrow morning.
- Action stage is 5.0 feet.
- Flood stage is 11.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

television, or NOAA Weather Radio for further information.

properties.headline: Air Quality Alert issued November 10 at 12:18PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...The South Coast AQMD has issued an air quality alert due to
harmful levels of fine particle pollution.
Visit https://www.aqmd.gov/alertinfo to check current and forecasted
air quality levels.

* WHERE...in Maywood, Bell Gardens, Westmont, Hawthorne and
Manhattan Beach. Levels of particle pollution can vary by time and
location depending on emissions and local weather conditions.

* WHEN...until 11:59 PM Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Particle pollution can get deep into the lungs and cause
serious health problems such as heart attacks, bronchitis, asthma
attacks, and difficulty breathing. Everyone can be affected, but
sensitive groups such as people with lung or heart disease, older
adults, people who are pregnant, children, and those who spend a lot
of time outdoors are at greater risk.
properties.instruction:
To protect your health, check air quality levels and act as needed:

* When Air Quality Index (AQI) levels are "Unhealthy for
Sensitive Groups" (orange), sensitive groups as specified
above should limit extended or intense outdoor activity.
* When AQI is "Unhealthy" (red), everyone may experience health
impacts. Sensitive groups should avoid extended time outdoors.
* When AQI is "Very Unhealthy" (purple), sensitive groups should
avoid all outdoor physical activity. Everyone else should
avoid extended or intense outdoor activity.
* When AQI is "Hazardous" (maroon), everyone should avoid all
outdoor physical activity.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

To help keep indoor air clean when air quality is poor:

* Keep windows and doors closed
* Run your air conditioner and/or an air purifier
* Do not use whole house fans or swamp coolers that bring in
outside air if you have other methods to stay cool
* Avoid other sources of pollution such as fireplaces, candles,
incense, grilling, and gasoline-powered lawn and garden
equipment
